# ⚔️ Mushoku Craft — Hardcore RPG Overhaul inspired by Mushoku Tensei

> *"Mastery over numbers. Skill over grind."*

**Mushoku Craft** is an ambitious, hardcore RPG total-conversion mod for Minecraft inspired by the universe of **Mushoku Tensei (Jobless Reincarnation)**. It completely reimagines combat, magic, crafting, and world exploration — replacing vanilla grind with systems that reward **player skill, knowledge, and mastery**.

You start as nobody — no magic, no sword techniques, nothing. Every ability must be **earned**.

---

## 🔮 Magic System

- **4 Schools of Magic** — Water, Fire, Earth, Wind — each with independent mastery progression
- **Spell Learning from Books** — hold the book, read the incantation, and attempt to learn. Base success rate: **25%**. On failure you only lose mana — the book stays
- **Fizzle Mechanic** — low mastery = chance of spell failure (interrupted cast, wasted mana). Mastery eliminates fizzle
- **Silent Casting** — at 100% spell mastery, incantation disappears, cast becomes **instant**, and you unlock **Hold-to-Charge** (hold to pour more mana into the spell for extra power)
- **Mentorship (Multiplayer)** — learn spells by standing near a casting master. Students inherit up to 20% of the teacher's mastery as a headstart
- **Mentorship (Singleplayer)** — learn from NPC masters in Magic Academies (rare world structures)
- **Spell Ranks** — Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced, and beyond

## ⚔️ Sword Combat & Touki (Battle Aura)

Three distinct **Sword God Styles**, switchable via stance menu:

| Style | Focus | Signature |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 **Sword God** | Offense | Extended reach, fast attacks, Longsword Light Flash dash |
| 🔵 **Water God** | Defense | Perfect parry (RMB), counter-attacks, projectile deflection |
| 🟣 **North God** | Trickster | Debuffs (bleed, slow), blade throwing, unpredictable strikes |

- **Touki (Battle Aura)** — unlocked at high style mastery, activated via radial menu. Continuously drains mana while providing style-specific combat bonuses that **scale with mastery**
- **Sword mastery** improves through combat and training on custom dummies

## 📖 Currently Implemented (v0.3.0 — Alpha 3)

*   ✅ Full **mana system** with passive regen, sleep-based full restore, and configurable HUD (Classic Bar / Dynamic Arc / Hybrid / Minimal)
*   ✅ **Magic Books** (Water, Fire, Earth) with 3D GeckoLib models and spell learning UI, now obtainable as rare loot in standard dungeons!
*   ✅ **Waterball spell** — full cast cycle with incantation text, fizzle mechanic, mastery-based cast time reduction, and silent casting at 100%
*   ✅ **Fireball spell** — explosive fire magic that sets the target area ablaze on impact!
*   ✅ **Rock Bullet spell** — piercing earth magic that scales in speed and damage the longer you charge it!
*   ✅ **Hold-to-Charge** mechanic for mastered spells — projectiles now smoothly sync with your camera direction in 1st-person view!
*   ✅ Spell Mastery system fully synchronizes with the R-menu during combat.
*   ✅ All **3 Sword Styles** with functional stance switching, unique attack modifiers, and custom player animations
*   ✅ **Water God Parry** — perfect parry window, counter-attacks, projectile deflection
*   ✅ **North God** — blade throwing, bleed/slow debuffs, fall damage reduction with Touki
*   ✅ **Sword God** — increased reach & attack speed
*   ✅ **Touki (Battle Aura)** — per-style bonuses (damage, defense, speed/jump), mana drain, toggle via radial menu

## 🗺️ Roadmap

### 🔜 Coming Soon
- 🔥 Fire, Earth, Wind spell schools with new spells
- 📕 Bestiary — scan defeated monsters to study their weaknesses and unlock damage bonuses
- 🌿 Herbalist Journal — discover and catalog magical plants for alchemy
- ⚗️ **Intelligent Alchemy** — no levels, pure player skill. Mortar & Pestle + Alchemy Cauldron with timing-based mini-games
- 🔨 **Modular Weapon Forging** — assemble unique weapons from Blade + Hilt + Monster Core on a Magic Anvil. Forging mini-game determines quality. Name your creation
- 🏛️ Magic Academies & Sword Dojos — rare generated structures with NPC masters and merchants

### 🔮 Future Vision
- 🐉 Custom boss mobs (Red Dragon, Orsted) with terrain-destructive AI, area attacks, and spawn zones
- 💍 Magic accessories (mana regen rings, amulets)
- 🌍 Full world generation overhaul with biome-specific magic creatures
- 🎓 Advanced mentorship system for multiplayer communities

## 🤝 We're Looking For Contributors!

**Mushoku Craft is an open community project and we need YOUR help to bring the Six-Faced World to Minecraft!**

We are actively looking for:

### 🎨 3D Modelers (Blockbench / GeckoLib)
- Custom mob models (Coati, Giant Frog, Stone Golem, Red Dragon, Orsted)
- Weapon and item models (modular swords, staves, alchemy equipment)
- Structure interiors (Magic Academies, Sword Dojos)
- Animated models with GeckoLib integration

### ☕ Java Developers (NeoForge)
- Combat systems & AI programming
- World generation (structures, biomes)
- Networking & multiplayer systems
- GUI/HUD development

### 🎵 Other Roles
- **Texture Artists** — mob textures, item sprites, UI elements
- **Sound Designers** — spell SFX, combat sounds, ambient audio
- **Translators** — help localize the mod to more languages

**Interested? Join our Discord:** [DISCORD](https://discord.gg/xAXTF4XUCh)
